what_happened.line: The committee voted unanimously to accept the superintendent's goals for the year, with an interim review set for the second January meeting.
The committee took up its own goals and the capital plan, which includes middle school ceiling asbestos abatement and a shade structure; the minutes record both outcomes as not audible.
The school building committee reported the construction cost after value engineering and the estimated tax effect of the building bond on an average bill.
The committee adopted a fuel efficient vehicle policy by unanimous vote.
The committee approved two small line item transfers and received the October 1 enrollment update and MCAS results from the principals.

why_it_matters: The new high school's construction cost and the bond's estimated effect on the average tax bill over 20 years bear directly on what residents will pay and on a later borrowing vote.
The capital plan sets which school building work, such as the middle school ceiling abatement, is scheduled to be funded; the minutes do not record how that vote went.
